formulas.description:
Used to determine the Next Invoice Date on the Confirm Service Contract Information screen.
If the Contract Start Date is in the past or within the next 30 days, then the formula returns today to inform finance that the invoicing needs to happen this month/period. Otherwise, if the Contract Start Date is greater than 30 days into the future, the formula returns the Contract Start Date minus 30 days.
formulas.name: formulaNextInvoiceDate

formulas.description: 1. Check if full name exceeds 120 2. If it does, truncate "Trust Group" and "Account Name" to 30 characters each
formulas.name: formulaOpportunityName
formulas.expression: "Renewal - " & IF( LEN("Renewal - " & {!recordId.Trust_Group__r.Name} & " - " & {!recordId.Account.Name} & " - " & TEXT({!recordId.Opportunity__r.Modality__c}) & " - " & TEXT(TODAY())) > 120, /* Truncate Trust Group to 30 chars */ LEFT({!recordId.Trust_Group__r.Name}, 30) & " - " & LEFT({!recordId.Account.Name}, 30) & " - " & TEXT({!recordId.Opportunity__r.Modality__c}) & " - " & TEXT(TODAY()), /* Use full string if under 120 */ {!recordId.Trust_Group__r.Name} & " - " & {!recordId.Account.Name} & " - " & TEXT({!recordId.Opportunity__r.Modality__c}) & " - " & TEXT(TODAY()) )
